title: Glob Guards Registry
description: D-124 (governance-roadmap item 7). Adopter-declared glob patterns that MUST continue matching at least min_matches files. Catches the class of bug where a CI trigger path, a generator's input directory, or a validation-loop target silently stops matching anything after a rename, restructure, or format migration, while whatever consumed it keeps reporting green. The default registry lives at .devai/config/glob-guards.json; absent or empty is valid (nothing declared, nothing to check).

description.description: Why this pattern is load-bearing and what would silently break if it stopped matching.

pattern.description: Glob pattern (minimatch syntax), relative to repo root.

min_matches.description: Minimum number of files the pattern must match. Defaults to 1 (pure zero-match detection); set higher to also catch partial coverage loss against a known-good baseline count.

source.description: Optional pointer to where this glob is consumed, e.g. a CI workflow path or a generator script path.
